routePolicy.currentScope: direct Cetus BTEN pairs + atomic via_bten multi-hop + composable return hops sealed once; Turbos adapters included in v17 plan
routePolicy.composableReceiptRule: open_composable_route -> one or more *_return hops -> seal_composable_route once

routeSelection.fallback: Compare-only display when a BTEN path is not net-cheaper. External volume that still hits a registered BTEN pool is emission-gated via attestation (counts toward settle), not by tape label.

aftermathSmartOrderRouter.rule: Independent direct-route comparator for quotes. If the resulting swap touches a registered BTEN Cetus pool, external attestation gates that digest for emission-block release. This helper does not itself unlock blocks.

traderReward.distribution: proportional to qualifying route points in that sealed round
traderReward.dappFlow: After a protected swap, check whether the wallet has an unpaid prior-round allocation; if so, add the payout call to the same wallet-signed transaction. Do not submit the payout call when no allocation exists.

protocolLiquidity.policy: BTEN-only positions are opened immediately adjacent to the live price. The Move call aborts atomically unless the paired asset quote is exactly zero.
protocolLiquidity.operator: The ops wallet owns the Cetus position objects; this is not a user-facing deposit flow.

nativeStakingFarm.dappRule: Use the farmObjectId from config/bten_staking_farm.json. Users stake BTEN and wallet-sign every action; the dapp never receives an admin capability.

externalCetusGate.dappRequirement: Bitcoin-style ~10 min cadence: settle releases at most 1 block per call. Attestation still accrues trader points. No bulk multi-block catch-up; advance_slots (600s) creates the next pending slot.

upgradeNotice: Read Published.toml and verification/manifest.json before constructing transactions after a package upgrade; package IDs and state IDs are versioned there.

managedRebalance.summary: Users add/remove any Cetus LP positions on block10.grok.me, set rebalance params, exit anytime. BTEN rebalances; 2% realized profit fee to ops.

turbosAdapters.note: Gated Turbos adapters live; v18 register_additional_pool is ready-for-use. Register a Turbos BTEN pool (bucket=3) before routing.

productGoals.note: Bitcoin-style ~10 min cadence. settle unlocks at most 1 block (MAX_SETTLE_BLOCKS=1) after advance_slots even when batch_trades==0. No bulk multi-block catch-up. Trades/attestations still credit trader rewards; they are not required to unlock.

liveTape.rule: Display only. Emission gating is attestation/recording that increments batch_trades. Tape rows may show gated for UX, but settle unlock requires an on-chain receipt.
liveTape.ungatedCetusBtenVolume: attest via bten::attest_external_cetus_route so aggregator/direct Cetus legs on registered BTEN pools count toward block release (one receipt per digest)
liveTape.externalCetusBtenVolume: attest via bten::attest_external_cetus_route so aggregator/direct Cetus legs on registered BTEN pools count toward block release (one receipt per digest)

gatePolicy.rule: Bitcoin-style ~10 min cadence. settle unlocks at most one pending ten-minute slot per call (MAX_SETTLE_BLOCKS=1) without requiring batch_trades. Adapter and external Cetus attestations still accrue trader points. Do not block transactions. Live-tape labels are not the gate.

liveTapeClassification.note: Tape classification is not emission gating. A row labeled gated on the tape does not unlock a block unless attest_external_cetus_route or a package adapter recorded the receipt.

gatePolicy.gatedMeans: time-pending slots release; trades not required

countsTowardBlockRelease: ExternalCetusRouteAttested (aggregator/direct Cetus on registered BTEN pools)
emissionGate.note: Bitcoin-style ~10 min cadence. settle unlocks at most 1 block (MAX_SETTLE_BLOCKS=1) after advance_slots even when batch_trades==0. No bulk multi-block catch-up. Trades/attestations still credit trader rewards; they are not required to unlock.

magmaBluefinAdapters.note: v18 register_additional_pool is live (bucket=2 Bluefin, Magma stays on attested Cetus). Native Magma/Bluefin CLMM adapters still wait on vendor interfaces.
